purpose: Add a volatile attention ecology above evidence-calibrated Spider edges: repeated patterns become visible, stale replay saturates and loses attention, fresh independent evidence can renew attention, and node focus migrates through bounded spiral graph propagation.

separation_of_weights.evidence_weight: Existing topa_spider_flywheel.py discovery/evidence-calibrated edge weight. Replaying identical evidence does not create new evidence or independence.
separation_of_weights.attention_weight: Volatile discovery priority. Repetition may raise it temporarily so a pattern is inspected, then replay fatigue lowers it when no new information arrives.
separation_of_weights.node_attention_A_t: Dynamic focus weight on graph nodes derived from incident attention plus bounded ring propagation. It is not truth, causality or proof.

edge_attention_dynamics.interpretation: Early repetition raises salience; after saturation, fatigue dominates. Contradictions may receive inspection attention without increasing truth-confidence.

node_attention_dynamics.local_signal: Weighted blend of max incident attention, top-3 mean incident attention and fresh-edge fraction, with mild high-degree normalization.
node_attention_dynamics.focus_rule: Dynamic upper-quartile attention threshold with at least one focus when a non-empty graph exists; at most five focus centers by default.

ecology_cycle: Give fresh evidence a novelty pulse.
Allow repeated patterns to accumulate temporary salience.
Apply replay fatigue once repetition ceases to add information.
Propagate attention across bounded graph rings so nearby context can become visible.
Select temporary focus centers from current attention only.
Decay stale edges/nodes and free attention for new patterns.
Renew attention when genuinely fresh evidence arrives.
Append all movements to history; never rewrite negative/stale history.

pippi_binding.role: PIPPI may supply chunk/relation history as Spider input and may store attention snapshots/movements. PIPPI Mirror may expose focus migration and stale-pattern decay to Pivot-Slime and Keymaster as advisory context only.
pippi_binding.training_label_rule: Attention states never become exact training labels unless backed by exact/source receipts appropriate to the domain.
